subject: general
question:
**In this question, the first and last sentences of the passage are numbered 1 and 6. The rest of the passage is split into four parts and named P, Q, R, and S. These four parts are not given in their proper order. Read the sentence and find out which of the four combinations is correct.**

S1: Calcutta unlike other cities kept its trams.

P : As a result there was horrendous congestion.

Q : It was going to be the first in South Asia.

R : They run down the centre of the road.

S : To ease in the city decided to build an underground railway line.

S6: The foundation stone was laid in 1972.

The Proper sequence should be:
solution:
The correct answer is '**RPSQ**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• While carefully reading all the statements it is clear that **sentence R **will come **after sentence S1.**
 
• This is because** sentence S1** is introducing us to the fact that **Calcutta had trams.**
 
• **Sentence R** is in **continuation **with **sentence S1** because is it telling us that these **trams used to run down the center of the road.**
 
• The **next statement** will be **sentence P** because it is telling us about the **problem **that was** caused by trams running on the road** i.e, **congestion**.
 
• **Sentence S** will come **next **because it is telling us about the **solution (underground railway line)** of the **problem (congestion on the road due to trams).**
 
• **Sentence Q **will come **last **because it is telling us that the **underground railway line that was going to be built was the first in South Asia.**
 
• Therefore, the **correct arrangement** is '**RPSQ**'.
 
• Hence, **option 4** is the correct answer.

 

**The correct arrangement is:**__ *They run down the center of the road. As a result, there was horrendous congestion. To ease in the city decided to build an underground railway line. It was going to be the first in South Asia.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• '**Horrendous**' means extremely unpleasant, horrifying, or terrible. (खराब)

 
 
• **Example**: She suffered **horrendous **injuries.
 
 
 
• '**Congestion**' means crowing. (भीड़)
 
 
• **Example**: The new bridge should ease **congestion **in the area.
